item.title: Viral Pink Eye Infection: Symptoms, Causes and How To Treat It
item.description: Viral pink eye is a highly contagious infection of the conjunctiva, often caused by the adenovirus. Symptoms include watery discharge, redness, and light sensitivity, frequently accompanying common cold symptoms. While it usually resolves in 7–14 days, experts warn that antibiotics are ineffective. Proper hygiene and cold compresses are the best ways to manage the spread.
